name: Rainbow
overview: In Genesis 9, God establishes a covenant with Noah, his descendants, and all living creatures, promising never again to destroy the earth by flood. The rainbow is given as a visible token of this covenant, set by God in the cloud as a perpetual sign between Him and the earth. This symbol not only represents God's faithfulness but also serves as a reminder that the earth will no longer be destroyed by floodwaters, highlighting its profound symbolic significance in Scripture.
